author: Play On Tabletop
description:
Mitchell has reached the end of his Gauntlet. What story will the dice tell in this battle brought to you by Baron of Dice: https://baronofdice.com/?ref=PiWj5cSTlKyTsZ . Get your dice from the Baron of Dice, and they carry Play On Tabletop official dice as well!

Will the Black Templar Crusade succeed or will the might of the Ultramarine's First Company finally get their brothers to comply with the codex Astartes? And what did Mitchell put on the line for this one?
